name_status: CODENAME , public name pending name-availability gate (not a brand decision)
premise: A quiet, monumental world of vast architectural interiors and raking northern light, where a single figure (AXIS) moves through bone-white and concrete spaces. Restraint over spectacle. The mood is editorial stillness, not cinematic drama.
environment_notes: Three anchor environments drawn from the locked 7-environment rotation. One environment per chapter. Each is large, sparse, and architectural; the figure is small within it.
light_logic: One dominant source per scene, cool north-light neutral. Hard-soft hybrid quality. Deep shadow tolerance, shadows may go fully dark. Raking, directional light that grazes surfaces. No colored gels, no practical neon, no lens flare.
camera_language: Editorial restraint. 50mm environmental and 85mm portrait. Static or very slow. Negative space dominant. Centered compositions or architectural rule-of-thirds aligned to the building's symmetry. Eye-level or slightly below.
recurring_motifs: a single human figure dwarfed by vast space
raking directional light across a bare surface
one oxblood accent object per frame, maximum
a doorway or aperture as a frame-within-the-frame
continuity_rules: one environment per chapter; do not mix environments in a sequence
palette is locked; oxblood appears at most once per frame
light direction stays consistent within a sequence
AXIS is the only recurring human figure; no other identified characters
no element from forbidden_elements may appear
sref slots stay fixed for the duration of a chapter once pulled
